Setup, and every item in the release: [README.md](README.md). Online: https://lede.cloudcompute.com/reference/checkbox.md A native `` that is its own hit target, sized by density, with an `indeterminate` state. ## Install ```bash npx shadcn@latest add @lede/checkbox ``` The command needs Lede's registry in `components.json`, as [README.md](README.md#use-it-in-a-shadcn-project) shows. It also installs the items [`lede-theme`](lede-theme.md) and [`lede-utils`](lede-utils.md). The item's JSON, with each file's source, is https://lede.cloudcompute.com/r/v0.7.2/checkbox.json. ## Import ```tsx import { Checkbox } from '@/components/lede/checkbox'; ``` ## Files and exports | Installs to | Import from | Exports | | --- | --- | --- | | `components/lede/checkbox.tsx` | `@/components/lede/checkbox` | `Checkbox` (component), `CheckboxProps` (type) | ## Props A native ``: keyboard, form and screen-reader behavior come from the browser, and the click event keeps its modifier keys (Shift for ranges).
